coverage.why: Measured 2026-10-06 after the #684 review (plan 101 sweep 10d: the review eval's scorers unit-tested, the draft-data escape tested): 73.9% of lines and 68.8% of functions locally; the floor is 73 / 68, under both and within the 1.5-point stale window of each. Earlier the same day, with the factory uses B16 added: 74.3% / 68.3% locally, 73.7% / 68.1% in CI (CI runs fewer live services, so less is reached) — 68 is under that CI figure too. Before: 72.7% of lines and 67.6% of functions, with the e2e suites' own fixtures excluded (see exclude) — they run in the e2e step against a real browser, and a browser-side helper added for #507's proof had pushed functions to 64.9%. Before that, 2026-10-02: 71.5% / 65.0% over 138 source files. What is not run: page renders (app/posts/[id]/page.tsx, site/pricing/page.tsx, site/blog/[slug]/page.tsx), the event handlers and mount() of every island (a unit test drives them through the built chunk, never this source), posts/service.ts past its first branch, and digest/jobs.ts, which the job suite runs and the unit suite does not. Each slice that adds a unit test raises this floor in the same commit.

exclude.why: the e2e suites' fixtures and drivers: each runs inside the e2e step against a real browser and a booted app, never under a unit test, so counting them weighed browser-side helpers (page-reads.ts, echo-hold.ts) against the unit floor
